name: analytics-attribution-fixture
goal: Exercise task analytics attribution with the qualified synthetic test fixture

evidence: The existing attribution case attempts a production worker, which correctly fails the provider qualification gate. Preserve the case and its two attempts, incomplete review, cost and idempotence assertions with an explicitly synthetic worker.
At 320db01472 the existing case validates committed fixture metadata, uses the in-process synthetic worker for both attempts, and shares its disposable analytics directory.

On harbor-mbp-2 the attribution file passed all three cases at 320db01472, including two submissions, a 0.5 review-derived bounce rate, reported token and cost totals, and idempotent reconciliation. The prior b808a310 run failed before provider launch; the fixture changed between runs.
